title: Disable CPU Idle States
name: cstates-off
modal: This keeps the CPU out of deep idle states from Windows for lower latency. Idle power usage will be higher.
description: Disables CPU idle states in the power plan to cut latency and micro-stutters in games
deepDescription:
Deep CPU idle states (C-States) add wake-up latency and micro-stutters. This disables processor idle in the active Windows power plan:

- Processor idle disable → On

Idle power draw is higher. Revert restores the default.
